The game takes place in ancient Terra-Nova, the year is 1409 of the Comet's Calendar. The party is a group of Magma Crystal harvesters, currently employed by [[Theryn's Drakebreakers]]. They harvest Magma Crystals from the Wyrmspire, on the island of the Wyrmlands. 

Players:
- Ariana: Navigator Faye
- Gray: Excavator Cinder
- Hunter: Captain Cyrus Ralowynn
- Corbin: Engineer Aubrim Ralowynn

They go to the spire and harvest crystals, avoiding dragons and wyverns. After harvesting crystals they return to Atlantis. They land at the industrial docks, and have their harvest audited by one of the managers. They access the MC value of your crystals and take what is required by the city, then pay you for the rest. 

Any other items you can collect like monster parts, rare materials, or whatever else must be sold on the black market, as your license is ONLY to collect magma crystals.

They are currently on a job, and have a quota of 2000 Mana Concentration to meet. They are at their third harvesting location, and still need 800 MC. There is a Mana Concentration meter on the lining of the crystal storage crate in the ships hold, and whoever is going excavating also has a handheld meter.

We begin, in the age of Aelaria, the Gods are alive, the sky is blue and the lay lines are strong. The ancient Druids of Tena still maintain the Oakenheart in contract with the white wizard of the Aelarian elves. The land is alive, the world is wild and magical, the peak of wonder and mysticism, but our adventure is not one so special. We are a crew of humble (but not too humble), and simple (but still quite dangerous) MAGMA CRYSTAL MINERS!

The magma pops and boils in the pit of the Wyrmspire, we find our heroes deep within the volcano. Cinder reaches his obsidian fist our and pulls a freshly harvested Magma Crystal from its holding. Gray can you please describe your character.
The rest of you stand nearby, Engineer Corbin checking his sensor to get a reading on the crystal's mana concentration, it reads 120. You know that this small crystal isn't enough. You have a quota of 2000 MC to return with, and you only have 1200 stored on the airship right now. Corbin can you please describe your character. 
Captain Cyrus stands guard, on a ledge above you and constantly scanning above and all around, waiting for the first threat to make itself known. 
Beside Cinder stands Corbin, visibly unhappy with the meager harvest so far. You've been to 2 harvest spots already and you haven't met the quota. You turn to your map maker to inquire about any possible routes to some decent harvest.

Faye, you know that everywhere you had mapped has either been harvested already this cycle, or you've been to. The only way there's anything left is your recently acquired map.
You guide the crew down a path they have never been down, all of you are on edge, its eerily quiet save the dark and ominous rumbles and shakes of the volcano.
